title: Prop-driven improvements of a v8.6 account (judged in dollars, not Sharpe): 1 small capped stress-book weight, 2 risk brakes, 3 funded behaviour
account: HyroTrader 2-Step $200k and CFT 2-Phase $200k; v8.6 hourly book (Gen322 cache, research costs) scaled to 15% vol on 2022-24; challenge 2.0 / funded 1.5; daily stop at 50% of the daily limit (hourly path)
criterion: 2022-24 block bootstrap (400 paths, block 20, seed 11): highest mean 2-year net with P(profit) >= 0.9 and p10 not lower than the baseline's p10 - 10%; each option vs the baseline, then the chosen options combined (kept only if the combination also wins on 2022-24)

options.P1 capped stress book in the account: account = unit(v8.6 + w x unit(stress book with the Gen369 T2 exposure cap)), w in {0.1, 0.2, 0.3}
options.P2a stop-day brake: risk x 0.5 on the UTC day after a day on which the 2.5% daily stop was hit (in the original series)
options.P2b volatility brake: risk x 0.5 on the day after a BTC daily move > 3 x its 30-day sd
options.P2c target brake: in a challenge phase, once equity >= 1 + 0.7 x the phase target, risk x 0.5 (engine option tgt_brake)
options.P3 funded cushion: on the funded account only, size x clip((equity - max-loss floor) / max loss, 0.25, 1) (engine cushion_scale, funded only)

report: 2025-26 once, at backtest level and at planning level (v8.6 shifted to 1.78 Sharpe), baseline vs chosen
